authority: Article XXXVI §8 (economics must be labeled by evidence tier)
purpose: Replace decorative price tags with reproducible economic models. Every claim carries one of three evidence tiers: MODELLED, PUBLICLY_VERIFIED, BUYER_VERIFIED.

MODELLED.definition: Derived from our internal model. Sourced inputs, but the output is a prediction, not a measurement.
MODELLED.constraint: A package may not enter TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY if its central value claim is MODELLED only and no path to PUBLICLY_VERIFIED or BUYER_VERIFIED exists. The path must be documented even if the verification hasn't happened yet.

PUBLICLY_VERIFIED.definition: Derived from a published measurement, peer-reviewed dataset, or regulatory filing.
PUBLICLY_VERIFIED.constraint: Citation required. Full provenance (publication, dataset DOI, or regulatory filing number).

BUYER_VERIFIED.definition: Derived from a specific buyer's actual data, under NDA, with the data source cited.
BUYER_VERIFIED.constraint: NDA reference required. Data source documented in buyer_intake_schema. Cannot be shared across buyers without renegotiation.

current_cost.description: What the buyer currently spends on the problem this candidate addresses.

components.name: direct_cost_per_year
components.notes: E.g., shunt revision surgery cost, complication treatment cost

components.name: total_current_cost_per_year
components.source: Sum of above; tier is the lowest of the inputs

components.name: intervention_description
components.value: Plain-language description of what the buyer adopts

components.name: intervention_unit_cost_USD
components.notes: Per-unit manufacturing cost at scale (e.g., 10K units/year)

components.name: intervention_deployment_cost_USD
components.notes: Cost to put the intervention in place (surgery, integration, training)

counterfactual.description: What changes for the buyer if they adopt this vs. the strongest comparator.

components.name: comparator_annual_cost_USD
components.source: Comparator's pricing or published cost data

annual_value_at_scale.description: Total annual value to a buyer at a defined deployment scale.

components.name: units_deployed_per_year
components.evidence_tier: BUYER_VERIFIED if specific buyer; MODELLED if archetype

development_cost.description: What it costs US to bring this from current state to deployable.

sensitivity_analysis.description: How does annual_value_total change when key inputs vary?

buyer_specific_value_range.description: For each buyer archetype, the value range.

buyer_archetypes.name: e.g., academic medical center, large shunt manufacturer, CNS biotech
buyer_archetypes.path_to_BUYER_VERIFIED: Specific outreach plan to convert MODELLED to BUYER_VERIFIED

transaction_target.description: What we are offering and at what rights level.

components.name: transaction_scope
components.value: Exclusive license | Non-exclusive license | Asset sale | Field-of-use license

components.name: field_of_use
components.value: e.g., hydrocephalus shunts only, or all CSF management

components.name: rights_differentiated_by_price_not_evidence
components.constitutional_basis: R275 STRATEGIC SHIFT — same evidence at every price tier; rights differentiate price, not evidence

evidence_tier_summary.description: How many of the value claims are at each evidence tier?
evidence_tier_summary.path_to_upgrade_central_claim: Concrete plan to move central claim from MODELLED to PUBLICLY_VERIFIED (or BUYER_VERIFIED). Required if central claim is MODELLED only.

labeling_rule: Every dollar value in the TTP must carry an evidence_tier. Values without a tier are FORBIDDEN. Composite values inherit the LOWEST tier of their inputs.

buyer_outreach_is_NOT_a_blocker.statement: Buyer outreach is CEO-owned. The machine's job is to deliver a package with MODELLED economics clearly labeled, plus a documented path to PUBLICLY_VERIFIED and BUYER_VERIFIED. The package does not wait for buyer contact.
buyer_outreach_is_NOT_a_blocker.implication: A candidate may enter TECHNOLOGY_TRANSFER_READY with central value claim at MODELLED, IF the path to upgrade is documented and the model itself is reproducible.
